item.title: Dungeon's Legion - Maou ni Sasagu Otome no Shitai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luna Soft
  • 発売日: 2020-08-15
  • スコア: 6.99/10 (140 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ダンジョンズレギオン-魔王に捧ぐ乙女の肢体-
  • 英語名: Dungeon’s Legion - Maou ni Sasagu Otome no Shitai

あらすじ

The Goddess of Chaos has reincarnated you as a Demon Lord in another world. Your mission is to lead the Forces of Chaos to victory over the Forces of Order. While your initial army consists of just a few goblins, you can grow your forces by employing even deadlier units such as ogres and daemons. As you defend your dungeon, you will encounter various heroines whom you can capture. Sway them into joining your cause and helping you protect your dungeon!

item.title: Ritaania no Seirei Tsukai -Meikyuu o Yuku Mono-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luna Soft
  • 発売日: 2017-02-24
  • スコア: 5.34/10 (162 人評価)
  • 日本語名: リターニアの精霊使い-迷宮を征く者-
  • 英語名: Ritaania no Seirei Tsukai -Meikyuu o Yuku Mono-

别名

  • Ritaania no Seirei Tsukai -Meikyuu o Yuku Mono-

あらすじ

In the peaceful Kingdom of Retarnia, which has known no war for five centuries, tranquility is shattered as portals to the Demon World burst open, unleashing sinister monsters intent on conquest.

This crisis mirrors an event from five hundred years ago, when the “Spirit Master of Retarnia” and his five spirits—Norn the White Spirit, Vesta the Red Spirit, Rusalka the Blue Spirit, Melissa the Green Spirit, and Iris the Black Spirit—fought the demons and sealed these portals.

item.title: Aku Ochi Labyrinth ~Toraware Maou to Naraku no Kyoujin~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luna Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-12-26
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 悪堕ラビリンス ～囚われ魔王と奈落の狂人～
  • 英語名: Aku Ochi Labyrinth Toraware Maou to Naraku no Kyoujin

别名

  • Wicked Labyrinth

あらすじ

Claude of the special Academy of Nobles wasn’t skilled in battle, magic or wits, and was insulted for his shortcomings by other students. In his heart he yearned for chaos to engulf the Academy.

Claude encountered Shiesta, the timid demon queen of the Hellrealm. She was compassionate, hoping that demons and humans could share the world. She had come on a mission of peace. But he only saw the chance to use her dark power against his fellow humans. Chaos would engulf the Academy, and he would be its master.

item.title: Soukyuu no Cradle -Ningyou Gakuen Choukyouki-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Luna Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-04-11
  • スコア: 5.6899999999999995/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 蒼穹のクレイドル －人形学園調教記－
  • 英語名: Soukyuu no Cradle -Ningyou Gakuen Choukyouki-

别名

  • Blue Sky Cradle‛： Exploit Record of Aion

あらすじ

Let’s embark on an adventure journey to become the strongest puppeteer in a world in which people who are absolutely obedient to human beings called magical dolls (Aion) and who obey any command are generalized!

Implemented a polite tutorial and system explanation from the beginning! On top of a game system centered on free upbringing and strengthening, a solid story about the origin of the magical doll Aion and the puppeteer is also developed!
